entities.text:
5.	SPLICE:
A.	FULL SPAN REBAR SHALL EITHER BE:
·	CONTINUOUS OVER MULTIPLE SPANS, OR
·	SPLICED (AS NEEDED FOR ERECTION/TRANSPORTATION PURPOSES) ONLY AT LOCATIONS SHOWN ON THESE DETAILS. ALL SPLICES SHALL BE CLASS "B" LAP SPLICE, EXCEPT THAT A 150mm+150mm SPLICE CAN BE PROVIDED FOR TOP REBAR AT MIDDLE STRIPS INTERIOR CONDITIONS (SEE DETAILS)
·	PARTIAL SPAN REBAR (E.G. 0.33 ℓn, 0.22 ℓn, ETC.) SHALL NOT BE SPLICED
6.	ALL REBAR SHALL BE CHAIRED UP
7.	HOOKS:
A.	PROVIDE STANDARD HOOKS AT ALL BOTTOM REBAR EXTERIOR SUPPORTS\PB.	AT EACH COLUMN STRIP, PROVIDE STANDARD HOOKS AT TOP TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT ENDS AT EXTERIOR SUPPORTS\PC.	AT SLAB EDGES, IF HOOKS EXCEED THE SLAB THICKNESS, HOOKS MAY BE SLIGHTLY SPUN AROUND THE REBAR AXIS AS NEEDED TO FIT THE HOOK WITHIN THE SLAB THICKNESS. DO NOT CUT THE LEG OF THE HOOK. SEE INSET DETAIL 'B'.\PD.	AT CONTRACTOR'S OPTION & S.E.O.R's APPROVAL, AND AT NO ADDITIONAL COST TO CLIENT, HEADED REBAR MAY BE PROVIDED IN LIEU OF STANDARD HOOKS AT SLAB EDGES TO RELIEVE REBAR CONGESTION.

entities.text:
8.	DISTRIBUTION OF TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT ACROSS ENTIRE SLAB:
	TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT SHALL BE ARRANGED WITH UNIFORM SPACING CALLED OUT ON PLANS FOR EACH DIRECTION, TOP AND BOTTOM, ACROSS THE ENTIRE SLAB.
9.	DISTRIBUTION OF ADDITIONAL REBAR ACROSS DESIGN STRIPS:
	ADD REBAR SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED/SPREAD ACROSS THE ENTIRE STRIP WIDTH AS SPECIFIED BELOW. DO NOT BUNDLE ADD REBAR IN ANY CASE.
A.	AT MIDDLE STRIP TOP AND BOTTOM POSITION, AND COLUMN STRIP TOP POSITION, ADD REBAR SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED WITH UNIFORM SPACING ACROSS THE STRIP WIDTH.\PB.	AT COLUMN STRIP BOTTOM POSITION, IF ONLY THREE OR FEWER ADD REBAR ARE SPECIFIED, PLACE SUCH REBAR IN CORRESPONDENCE TO THE CONCRETE COLUMN BELOW. OTHERWISE, 75% OF ADD REBAR SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED WITH UNIFORM SPACING ACROSS A 1800mm WIDE "BAND" EXTENDING 900mm ON EACH SIDE OF THE CENTER LINE OF THE COLUMN, AND THE REMAINDER SHALL BE DISTRIBUTED EVENLY ACROSS THE REST OF THE STRIP.\PC.	EACH ADD REBAR LOCATION SHALL BE ADJUSTED AS NEEDED TO MAINTAIN ADEQUATE CLEAR SPACING FROM OTHER REBAR, INCLUDING TYPICAL REINFORCEMENT.
